description: Source file implementing WGL (Windows OpenGL) surface for D3D texture interop in ANGLE project, including functions for texture info retrieval, surface initialization, locking/unlocking, and resource management.

classes.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL
classes.description: WGL surface implementation for D3D texture interop, managing resource registration, locking, unlocking, and framebuffer creation.

methods.name: ValidateD3DTextureClientBuffer
methods.description: Validates the D3D texture client buffer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface, registers resources, and creates renderbuffers.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Locks the D3D resource for current use.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Queries surface attributes like share handle and mutex.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Indicates if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates default framebuffer for the surface.

methods.name: getD3DTextureColorFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D texture color format.
